trigger_signature: a research atom proposes proving vanishing of an obstruction as a simplification of a lifting/existence target
the obstruction surface may be complete (zero iff lift) or only detector-like
context_scope: first-order deformation/lifting problems with a fixed source object and a map to a base
applies only after the exact obstruction completeness semantics are source-bound
action: Before crediting obstruction vanishing as a route reduction, type the obstruction as COMPLETE_OBSTRUCTION or DETECTOR_ONLY. If complete, normalize vanishing back to the corresponding liftability/tangent-surjectivity condition; if detector-only, require a separate sufficiency argument.
expected_effects: prevent tautological route renaming from being counted as progress
expose when a detector-only vanishing statement cannot close a lifting arrow
redirect search toward independently checkable geometry that proves actual reachability
boundaries: does not prove any obstruction vanishes
does not apply unchanged to nonlinear higher-order obstruction towers
does not infer algebraization or globalization from first-order lifting
one Hodge application episode gives candidate authority only
falsifier: Find a fresh, exactly typed first-order lifting problem with a complete obstruction theory where obstruction vanishing on a base subspace is not equivalent to liftability along that subspace, or show that the proposed normalization causes a false route-pruning under the exact source semantics.
validation_obligations: fresh transfer to at least one non-Hodge deformation problem under frozen context
check false-positive risk when obstruction theories have multiple stages or noncanonical obstruction spaces
no ResearchTool or framework promotion without protected validation
